summary: Texture surface descriptor allocation and creation (canonical name TextureSurfaceAllocation, ABI name Texture_Surface_Allocation). Allocates a 76-byte block with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, marks its header as 2, and zeroes two 9-DWORD (36-byte) descriptor blocks. Stores the first descriptor block pointer at this+4428 (this+0x114C), then fills both blocks with the same per-block constants: 34 at the block header, 322 at +4, 24 at +8, and the a2 argument at +12 for the first block; 34 at +36, 322 at +40, 24 at +44, and a2 at +48 for the second. Calls sub_540DF0 (0x00540DF0) once per descriptor block, returning -1 if either call fails and 0 on success. Called by sub_544740 (0x00544740).

operations.description: Allocate a 76-byte block via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03); when the allocation succeeds, set the block header *v3 = 2 and zero the following 18 DWORDs as two 9-DWORD descriptor blocks (v6[0..8] per block with v6 advancing by 9 DWORDs, two iterations).
Store the first descriptor block pointer (v3 + 1) at this+4428 (this+0x114C).
Initialize the first descriptor block: header value 34 at the block base, 322 at +4, 24 at +8, and the a2 argument at +12.
Initialize the second descriptor block (at *(this+0x114C) + 36): 34 at +36, 322 at +40, 24 at +44, and a2 at +48.
Call sub_540DF0 (0x00540DF0) with this and the first descriptor block pointer (*(this+0x114C)); on a non-zero result return -1.
Call sub_540DF0 (0x00540DF0) with this and the second descriptor block pointer (*(this+0x114C) + 36); on a non-zero result return -1.
Return 0 when both surface creation calls succeed.

unresolved: If the allocation returns null the decompiler output contains no guard: desc stays 0 and the subsequent writes dereference null, which would fault at runtime; the success path is assumed.
The constants 34, 322 and 24 are not independently identified as a surface format enum, width or height; the a2 argument is passed through unchanged without a confirmed semantic.
